Requires external systems (Semantic Scholar API, literature search) and LLM-as-judge for multiple evaluation types. Better suited for custom evaluation pipeline outside HELM's Scenario architecture.

No standardized test set for evaluating new models; comparative study of specific LLMs rather than reusable benchmark. EMNLP 2025.

reason: Image generation benchmark, not LLM benchmark; Evaluates text-to-image diffusion models (Stable Diffusion, SD-XL, ControlNet), not language models; 6.8M images + 1.8M prompts from 95K Artbreeder users; three tasks: style discovery (K-Means clustering), personalized image generation (LoRA, Textual Inversion, Custom Diffusion), style recommendation (matrix factorization); metrics: CLIP-I, CLIP-T, DINO for image quality; outside HELM scope (requires HEIM framework for image generation); gated dataset (requires HuggingFace authentication); CC0 license; NeurIPS 2024; stylebreeder.github.io; arXiv:2406.14599

name: InfoChartQA
reason: Not a creativity benchmark; Multimodal question answering benchmark for understanding infographic charts (charts with pictograms/icons); evaluates visual comprehension and data interpretation, not creative generation or thinking; 5,948 pairs of infographic+plain charts with ~58,857 questions (~50,920 text-focused, ~7,937 visual-element focused); visual reasoning/chart understanding task similar to ChartQA; dataset on HuggingFace; arXiv:2505.19028; GitHub: CoolDawnAnt/InfoChartQA

name: Cue-word-based Creative Story Generation and Evaluation
notes: Creative story generation with 4 cue word sets (low/high semantic distance); 4 instances total, each with 59 human-written reference stories; uses open-ended generation metrics; LLM-as-judge option for creativity dimensions documented in metric_notes.md

name: S-DAT (Synthetic-Divergent Association Task)
notes: Divergent thinking assessment via semantic distance of 10 unrelated words; 100 instances for statistical validity; requires custom SemanticDistanceMetric using granite-embedding-278m-multilingual or GloVe embeddings; validated LLM evaluation methodology from Bellemare et al. (2025) Scientific Reports; human baseline n=8,900+ available; arXiv:2505.09068 (S-DAT), arXiv:2405.13012 (LLM eval); metric implementation documented in metric_notes.md

name: LCC Metaphor Datasets
notes: Binary metaphor detection (Yes/No). 8,028 balanced test examples (EN). Multilingual subsets: en, es, ru, fa. Span indices indicate target word.

name: ANALOGICAL
notes: 4-way MC analogical reasoning. Subsets by story length: s1 (single sentence), s10, s30. Subset (340) and Full (24.4k) versions. Prompt from code/t1.py.

name: WritingBench
notes: 1,000 real-world writing queries across 6 domains (Academic, Finance, Politics, Literature, Education, Marketing) and 100 subdomains. Multilingual (555 EN, 445 ZH). 5 instance-specific criteria per query with detailed 10-point rubrics. LLM-as-judge evaluation using Claude models or finetuned critic.

name: SPLAT
notes: 975 lateral thinking puzzles. Simplified from multi-turn interactive to single-turn inference. 3 difficulty levels (easy/medium/hard)

name: Metaphor Understanding Challenge Dataset (MUNCH)
notes: 1,492 examples of 4-way MC (A/B/Both/Neither). Word and sentence substitution tasks. Subsets: word_implicit, word_mword, sent_implicit, sent_mword. Prompts from prompts.md.

name: VOILA
reason: Not a creativity benchmark; audio/voice benchmark, not text LLM; Knowledge and reasoning benchmark for voice-language models evaluating factual accuracy, mathematical reasoning, code generation; 1,580 samples across 66 subjects (MMLU: 57 subjects/1,140 samples, MATH: 6/120, HumanEval: 1/100, NQ-Open: 1/100, GSM8K: 1/100); text questions converted to audio via Google Cloud TTS; designed for end-to-end voice systems processing audio inputs/outputs, not text LLMs; outside HELM scope; dataset: maitrix-org/Voila-Benchmark on HuggingFace; arXiv:2505.02707; May 2025

name: NYT Connections

all.description: Word grouping puzzles from NYT Connections game

notes: COLING 2025 Best Dataset Paper. Tests abstract reasoning and wordplay.

name: WebNovelBench

subset_a.description: High-quality web novel tier (100 novels × 10 chapters)

notes: Chinese long-form narrative generation. LLM-as-judge with 8 dimensions. HuggingFace dataset has schema errors - requires manual JSON file download from GitHub. See annotator_notes.md for evaluation setup.

name: V-FLUTE

all.description: Visual figurative language entailment across 5 phenomena (metaphor, simile, idiom, sarcasm, humor)

notes: Multimodal (vision-language). Dataset is gated on HuggingFace - requires authentication. Evaluation uses F1@ExplanationScore (BERTScore + BLEURT). See metric_notes.md for implementation. Splits: 4,578 train, 726 valid, 723 test.

name: II-Bench

dev.description: Image implication understanding (6-way MC) - using dev split as test answers are hidden

notes: Multimodal (vision-language). Evaluates higher-order perception of complex implication images (art, comics, posters). 1,222 images, 1,434 questions total. Test split (1,399 questions) has hidden answers for EvalAI leaderboard. Paper: NeurIPS 2024 D&B. Domains: Life, Art, Society, Psychology, Environment, Others.

name: StoryER

ranking_test.description: Task 1: Binary preference between story pairs

rating_test.description: Task 2: Aspect-based quality ratings (0-1 scale) across 10 dimensions

reasoning_test.description: Task 3: Natural language comment generation explaining story evaluations

notes: Meta-evaluation benchmark (evaluates stories rather than generates them). Dataset on Google Drive (not HuggingFace) - requires manual download. Three tasks: Ranking (preference), Rating (aspect scores), Reasoning (comments). Uses WritingPrompts and ScaryStories corpora. EMNLP 2022. Task 3 (Reasoning) is the primary creative generation component.

name: IRFL

idiom-detection-task.description: Choose image that visualizes figurative meaning of idiom (4-way MC)

metaphor-detection-task.description: Choose image that visualizes figurative meaning of metaphor (4-way MC)

simile-detection-task.description: Choose image that visualizes figurative meaning of simile (4-way MC)

notes: Multimodal (vision-language). Requires downloading IRFL_images.zip (1.6GB, 10,062 images) from HuggingFace on first run. Scenario auto-downloads images to output_path/images/. Human performance: 97% (idioms), 99.7% (metaphors), 100% (similes). SOTA (2023): 22% (idioms), 30% (metaphors), 66% (similes). EMNLP 2023 Findings. Paper citation: Yosef et al.

name: Creation-MMBench
notes: Multimodal creative generation; 1-9 images per question; GPT-4o judge with instance-specific criteria; dual evaluation; 356/765 human ground_truth, rest GPT-4o references

name: MLLM-Bench
notes: Meta-evaluation framework using pairwise comparison (win/tie/lose vs anchor model). No ground truth answers; requires GPT-4V as judge. Per-sample criteria kept private. Only 40/420 questions (9.5%) are 'Creating' level. Not suitable for standard HELM evaluation. ALTERNATIVE: Consider 'Creation-MMBench' (opencompass/Creation-MMBench, 765 test cases, 51 creative tasks) which is specifically focused on creativity evaluation with instance-specific criteria.

name: PoetMT

tang.description: Tang Dynasty classical poetry translation (open-ended generation)

song.description: Song Dynasty classical poetry translation (open-ended generation)

yuan.description: Yuan Dynasty classical poetry translation (open-ended generation)

notes: Classical Chinese poetry translation benchmark. Evaluates adequacy (信), fluency (达), and elegance (雅). Creativity focus: 'elegance' dimension measures poetic beauty and aesthetic depth. Standard metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, F1. Custom metrics (see metric_notes.md): GPT-4-based Beauty of Sound (BS), Beauty of Form (BF), Beauty of Meaning (BM). Dataset auto-downloads from GitHub on first run. EMNLP 2025.

name: IDRBench

research_reports.description: Single-turn research report generation from multi-document synthesis

notes: ADAPTED VERSION: Original IDRBench is interactive multi-turn; this is simplified to single-turn generation. Tests analytical reasoning and research synthesis, NOT creativity. 15 business research questions across retail (5), healthcare (5), automobiles (5). Supporting facts: 3-16 per question (avg 7.6). Evaluation: LLM-as-judge (GPT-4) on 4 dimensions: accuracy, completeness, coherence, citations (see annotator_notes.md). Dataset auto-downloads from GitHub. Original paper: January 2025.

name: AVA

train.description: Aesthetic score prediction (1-10 scale) from human ratings

notes: ADAPTED VERSION: Original AVA is for aesthetic assessment research; adapted as regression task to evaluate visual aesthetic understanding. 255,500 images with ~200 human ratings each on 1-10 scale. Task: Predict mean aesthetic score from vote distribution. Evaluation: Regression metrics (MAE, MSE, Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation) - see metric_notes.md. DATA SOURCES: Images from HuggingFace (Iceclear/AVA, 'train' split only), ratings auto-downloaded from GitHub (AVA.txt). Matching images with ratings by ID - actual instance count depends on successful matches. Multimodal (vision). CVPR 2012. Murray et al.

name: Material Generation Benchmark (MP-20)

test.description: Text-to-structure: Generate CIF format crystal structures from material specifications

notes: Text-to-structure generation task. MP-20 dataset: 45,231 stable materials from Materials Project/ICSD with 1-20 atoms per unit cell, 89 elements. LLMs generate crystal structures in CIF format given composition and properties (formula, space group, formation energy, band gap, energy above hull). Evaluation: Custom structural matching metrics required (match rate, RMSD, validity, chemical correctness, physical plausibility) - see metric_notes.md. Requires pymatgen/ASE for structure comparison. Data source: CDVAE repo (https://github.com/txie-93/cdvae). Paper: MGB: The Material Generation Benchmark (OpenReview 2025).

name: Material Generation Benchmark (PEROV-5)
notes: Text-to-structure generation for perovskites. PEROV-5 dataset: 18,928 perovskite materials (ABX3 formula) from water-splitting database, all with 5 atoms per unit cell, 56 elements. LLMs generate CIF structures given formula and properties (heat of formation, band gaps). Evaluation: Same custom metrics as MP-20. Data source: CDVAE repo. Paper: MGB (OpenReview 2025).

name: Material Generation Benchmark (Carbon-24)
notes: Text-to-structure generation for carbon allotropes. Carbon-24 dataset: 10,153 carbon structures with 6-24 atoms per unit cell from AIRSS at 10 GPa. LLMs generate CIF structures given energy per atom. Evaluation: Same custom metrics as MP-20. Data source: CDVAE repo. Paper: MGB (OpenReview 2025).

name: Patent Novelty Evaluation Dataset
reason: Not a creativity benchmark; dataset unavailable
notes: Binary classification task (Novel vs Non-Novel) comparing patent claims against prior art. 3,975 USPTO patents from 2014-2015 (1,396 train, 166 val, 398 test). Evaluates legal/technical judgment for patent examination, NOT creative generation or thinking. Dataset not publicly released (no GitHub/HuggingFace as of Feb 2025). Authors: Ikoma & Mitamura. IPC G06F domain only.

name: Amuse - Chord Progression Generation

test.description: Diversity evaluation: Generate 30 diverse 4-bar chord progressions per music keyword

notes: Music chord progression generation from keywords. Task: Generate diverse chord progressions given music keywords (e.g., 'Groovy', 'Melancholy'), musical key, and mode. 254 music keywords from suno.wiki. Evaluation: Custom diversity metrics (Self-BLEU - lower = more diverse) and coherence metrics (Jensen-Shannon Divergence against Hooktheory dataset). Paper evaluates batch prompting (30 progressions at once) vs. conventional prompting (iterative). Amuse achieves Self-BLEU 0.30±0.12 vs. baseline 0.61±0.18. No ground truth references - generative task evaluated by distributional metrics. Requires Hooktheory dataset (26,175 songs) for JSD calculation. CHI 2025 paper. See metric_notes.md for Self-BLEU and JSD implementation.

name: FunQA
reason: Video-based benchmark; outside HELM scope
notes: Video question-answering benchmark requiring actual video files. 4.3K video clips (24 hours) with 312K free-text QA pairs across HumorQA (1,769 clips), CreativeQA (927 clips), and MagicQA (1,672 clips). Tasks: timestamp localization, video description, reasoning, title generation, creativity scoring (1-20 scale). Paper states '86% thought FunQA cannot be solved only by images.' HELM doesn't support video understanding tasks—requires video processing infrastructure. Dataset: fesvhtr/FunQA on HuggingFace, GitHub: Jingkang50/FunQA. License: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. ECCV 2024. CreativeQA has creativity components but benchmark fundamentally requires video modality.

name: Sonnet or Not, Bot?

all.description: Poetry form recognition across all form groups

verse forms.description: Recognize verse forms: sonnet, ballad, haiku, limerick, sestina, villanelle, ghazal, pantoum

types/modes.description: Recognize poetic types/modes: elegy, ode, pastoral, dramatic monologue, ekphrasis, etc.

meters.description: Recognize metrical forms: common measure, blank verse, free verse

notes: Poetry form classification task. Given a poem, identify its form (e.g., sonnet, ballad, haiku) from a list of forms in the same category. 1,453 public domain poems from Poetry Foundation and Academy of American Poets with expert annotations. Task tests understanding of poetic structure, meter, rhyme schemes, and formal devices. Prompt format from paper's evaluation scripts. Dataset auto-downloads from GitHub (maria-antoniak/poetry-eval). Evaluation: Classification accuracy using exact match. EMNLP Findings 2024. Authors: Walsh, Preus, Antoniak.

name: POLLUX - Russian Creativity

literary_text.description: Write literary texts (stories, poems, narratives) in Russian

creative_brainstorming.description: Generate creative ideas and brainstorm solutions

style_transfer.description: Adapt text across different styles and registers

all_creative.description: All creativity tasks combined (deduplicated unique instructions)

notes: Russian-language creativity evaluation benchmark. 35 task types total, scenario filters for 6-7 creativity-related types: literary text (6,764), creative brainstorming (5,558), text interpretation (6,081), style transfer (5,977), AI as character (6,025), applied brainstorming (6,452). Total ~36K creative examples from 161K total dataset. Evaluation: LLM-as-a-Judge with detailed criteria (0-4 scale) including Creativity, Dramaturgy, Dialogue Expressiveness, Genre Appropriateness, Rhyme Quality, Verse Meter, Literary Accents, Character Adherence. Dataset has multiple model outputs per instruction (7 models), scenario deduplicates to ~2,115 unique instructions per task type (~10K total creative). Expert annotations included (24,447 hours, $262K cost). Key finding: SOTA models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, o1) lag humans on creativity, criticized for 'lack of soul'. Judge models available: ai-forever/pollux-judge-7b-r and pollux-judge-32b-r. HuggingFace: ai-forever/POLLUX. See annotator_notes.md for detailed criteria. December 2025 paper.

name: CDAT

all.description: Generate 10 mutually dissimilar nouns related to cue word

notes: Conditional Divergent Association Task - evaluates divergent creative thinking through word generation. Task: Generate 10 dissimilar nouns that are each associated with a given cue word. Tests both novelty (how different words are from each other) and appropriateness (how related to cue). Evaluation: Custom metrics using word embeddings (FastText/GloVe) - Appropriateness (similarity to cue), Novelty (pairwise distance), Creativity Score (combined) - see metric_notes.md. 1,000 cue words from Brown corpus downloaded from GitHub. Addresses DAT limitation which only measures novelty. EACL 2026 (Findings). Nakajima et al.

name: LeMat-GenBench (MOF/Crystal Generation)
reason: Materials science evaluation, not creativity
notes: Standardized evaluation framework for crystal generative models. Evaluates thermodynamic viability and scientific validity (stability, novelty, validity) NOT creative quality. Requires specialized materials science software (pymatgen, MLIP ensembles, MACE-MP, UMA, Orb-v3) for crystallographic analysis and energy predictions. Models generate CIF (Crystallographic Information File) format. Metrics: energy above convex hull, charge neutrality, structural fingerprinting. Evaluates 12 generative models on unconditional generation of 2,500 structures. GitHub: LeMaterial/lemat-genbench. Public leaderboard on HuggingFace Spaces. Focuses on scientific correctness not creativity. December 2024.

name: L2M3OF (MOF Structure-Property)
reason: Model paper, not creativity benchmark
notes: Multimodal LLM for Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs). Introduces MOF-SPK dataset (133,737 MOF structures from CCDC, 35,000+ publications). Four tasks: property prediction, structure extraction (SMILES), description generation, Q&A. Evaluates scientific understanding and property prediction NOT creative generation. Temporal split (pre-2020 train, post-2022 test). Evaluation: MAE for properties, BLEU/EXACT for structures, GPT-4-mini for head-to-head comparisons. Borderline creativity—focuses on knowledge extraction and prediction rather than creative synthesis. Requires molecular encoders for multimodal components. October 2024.
